fixes.explanation: Harmless is the word, and it's good news. Verse 39 says, “…if the spots are dull white, it is a harmless rash that has broken out on the skin; the person is clean.” The priest looks, the spots are dull white, and the person is clean. I do a happy dance right here on my gold base. Dull white spots, harmless rash, clean.

problems.problem: Verse 39 says the priest examines the spots and the person is clean; it does not say the priest pronounces the person clean.
